name: Karen Clavius
original_name: カレン・クラヴィウス
source:
Karen is the secretary and Military Ambassador of the Kingdom of Sphere. She seems to have a fairly strict attitude on things which fits her profession well. Is in charge of making sure nothing happens to Feena. Good friends with Sayaka since her time in the Moon. Has a complex about her small chest.
